Overview

Zaria is a city in Kaduna with a population of 975,000. A historic city in northern Nigeria, home to Ahmadu Bello University and a center of Hausa culture and Islamic learning. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
